allowedControls: fake transports; trusted local hash/parser controls; Node builtin fs/crypto on isolated synthetic tmp fixtures only

authorization: No authorization/malformed/wrong plan,closure,source,projection,image,scope,output,scratch must refuse before daemon.
Exclusive output and scratch; preflight failures after accepted auth retain attempt/effort without claiming daemon absence from a failed call.
commands: Only frozen go env/go list/go test-list invocations; no npm,Hereby,gotestsum,helper compilation/install or tests/native task run.
Exact cwd/source go.work,local toolchain,proxyoff/sumdboff,CGO and compiler context frozen; no inherited credentials/tags/flags/config.
Collection can compile/init/TestMain; never advertise no upstream execution for a future actual run.
inputs_and_observer: Exact source/projection hashes and inventory/regular-safe path bounds; no npm subtree or buildcache.
Full source and tool inventory before/after; digest type/path/link/mode/content completeness,unknown/mutation failure closed.
Node builtin-only observer controls permitted only on isolated synthetic fs fixtures, no project/npm imports.
isolation: Exact no-network,nonroot,readonly,dropALL,no CapAdd,private namespaces,no mounts/socket/host env; reject unknown altered inspect values.
Fixed image ID,3CPU4GiB/equal swap256PID8GiBworkspace,900s+60cleanup; explicit exec tmpfs and TMPDIR/workspace; no resource expansion.
lifecycle: Create/admission/seed/env/list/collect/observer failures and timeout/cancel retain stage/usage/failure; cleanup attempted on every created/maybe-created handle and independently retain absence outcome.
Output caps/transport caps/watchdog disconnects/missing final receipts never produce qualified success.
Unknown costs remain null with exclusions; all campaign/task/native/global flags false even successful collection.
parser: Full lossless stream,real stderr and exit/error; no printable-only filtering or truncation tolerated.
No empty/malformed/trailing/duplicate/contradictory package or listing stream; retain zero-test packages but reject missing package closure.
Unexpected lifecycle/run/bench output or package errors fail collection; no inferred dynamic subtests,capability skips or body outcomes.
Collection manifest package identity and top-level Test/Example/Fuzz candidates bound to actual package metadata,listing and source; no packageprefix alias.

roleDisclosure: Reviewer authored prior source-only plan and Go-only projection, not collection driver. Independent implementation review, not blind task trial.
